entry.name: SAS Certified Professional: AI and Machine Learning
entry.note: Awarded after three SAS specialist credentials: machine learning, forecasting and optimization, and natural language processing and computer vision
entry.renewal: Expires 5 years from the date earned
entry.audience: Analysts and data scientists working in SAS and open source tools

reading.format: Awarded after earning three SAS Certified Specialist credentials: Machine Learning, Forecasting and Optimization, and Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision.
reading.summary: This credential shows ability to use open source and SAS tools to get insight from data. It is awarded after earning three SAS specialist credentials in machine learning, forecasting and optimization, and natural language processing and computer vision. Holding it validates AI and analytics talent.
reading.audience: People who want to expand career potential or stand out in a competitive field and show AI and analytics skills.
reading.validity: Expires five years from the date the certification is earned. The underlying credentials may expire at different times, but that will not cause this credential to expire before the five year date.
reading.prerequisites: Must earn the SAS Certified Specialist: Machine Learning credential, the SAS Certified Specialist: Forecasting and Optimization credential, and the SAS Certified Specialist: Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision credential.
